invoice_clauses.10.1: Each invoice quotes the contract number on the face of this Agreement, the facility code and the Patient's plan tier, and carries an invoice number unique across the term.
invoice_clauses.10.2: Every Service Date falls within the term and may not fall after the invoice date.
invoice_clauses.10.3: The same Service may not be billed twice for the same Patient and the same Service Date, whether on one invoice or across several.

conventions.1.2: The Provider operates the following facilities. The facility code recorded on a line item determines which column of Table 2 applies.
conventions.1.3: Patients are enrolled in one of the following plan tiers. The plan tier recorded on an invoice determines which column of Table 3 applies to every line item on that invoice.
conventions.2.2: "Business Day" means any Service Day other than a Saturday or a Sunday.
conventions.3.1: Where more than one adjustment applies to the same Service, the adjustments shall be applied to the base rate strictly in the following order: (a) substitution of a bundled rate; (b) the facility multiplier; (c) the plan-tier multiplier; (d) any premium or uplift; and (e) any cumulative volume discount. The line total is then the resulting unit rate multiplied by the billed quantity.
conventions.3.2: All monetary amounts are expressed in whole cents. Where the application of a multiplier, premium or discount produces a fraction of a cent, the result shall be rounded to the nearest whole cent, with exact halves rounded away from zero ("half up"). Rounding is applied after each individual step of the calculation, not once at the end.
conventions.3.3: In full, the calculation is: take the base rate for the Service from Table 1 (or the substituted bundled rate from Section 7 where that applies); multiply by the facility multiplier for that Service and facility from Table 2; multiply by the plan-tier multiplier for that Service and tier from Table 3; apply any premium from Section 5 or Section 6; and finally apply any cumulative volume discount from Section 8. Round half up to the nearest cent after each of those steps.
conventions.3.4: A multiplier of 1.0 leaves the amount unchanged, but the rounding step is still taken.
conventions.5.1: Assessed against the aggregate quantity of the Service delivered to the Patient on the Service Day, across all line items and all invoices.
conventions.7.1: Where both Services in a pair are delivered to the same Patient on the same Service Day, the substituted rates below replace the Table 1 base rates. The facility and plan-tier multipliers are then applied to the substituted rate.
conventions.8.1: Cumulative utilisation is counted cumulatively across the whole term of this Agreement and aggregated across all Patients, in Service Date order, and is not reset by a change of facility or of plan tier. Where two line items share a Service Date they are counted in ascending order of line identifier. Where two thresholds are met the deeper discount applies.
